details:
The current avatar upload limit system creates two major issues:

Restricts legitimate creators who want to upload multiple quality avatars

Fails to prevent spam of low-effort avatars that clutter the platform and make discovery difficult

Proposed Solution

Replace the current upload limit system with a small fee structure:

Fee amount: $0.25-0.50 per avatar upload

No upload limits - creators can upload as many avatars as they want

Economic filter naturally discourages spam while remaining accessible

Benefits

Quality improvement: Small economic barrier encourages creators to put more effort into each avatar

Reduced spam: Children and casual spammers will think twice before uploading low-effort content

Creator freedom: Serious creators no longer constrained by arbitrary limits

Platform revenue: Generates income to support VRChat development

Better discovery: Fewer junk avatars makes finding quality content easier

Implementation

Fee charged per upload attempt

Payment integrated with existing VRChat economy

Clear messaging about quality expectations

Optional: Partial refunds for highly-rated avatars to incentivize excellence

This system maintains VRChat's creative accessibility while naturally filtering out content that doesn't add value to the community.
title: Micro-fee Avatar Upload System: Quality Control Through Economic Incentive
